issues: Two white windows and a white paper plane on a light-grey backdrop: hero and background shared a colour, so the plane all but vanished in flight
Pulled back, window text was 13–15px at 0.6 zoom, about 8–9px on screen, and even the opening close-up body text was only ~23px
Parallax props were grey message bubbles and defocused rings that read as scattered UI scraps, with no sense of flying through air
The dotted trail was thin and faint, and the plane reached its slot before the new row opened, as if it crashed into an old row
changes: Midnight look (deep navy, electric blue): two dark glass windows float in a night sky, and the only bright thing in the world is the white paper plane with a soft halo and a trail that brightens toward the head (wide glow plus a thin bright core)
Parallax is now a three-layer night sky: 170 twinkling stars (depth 0.28), thin mid clouds, and defocused near wisps sweeping past the lens, all gradients with no live blur
Windows are laid out for camera: ~39px body text at the 1.5 close-up; after takeover (zoom 2, the window exactly fills frame) names are 52px and previews 44px

Closed cause and effect: after the click the button slides to 'Sent ✓'; the new row opens 8f early to clear an empty slot, the plane tucks into the avatar with an accent ripple, and the badge flips to '1 new'
172f: 12f close-up, pull back 1.5→0.5, a 76f chase flight (slowly pushing to 0.56), a 32f takeover to 2.0, and a 30f inbox hold
